checks.name: visible main window obtains foreground focus
keyboard press reaches the emulated A button
keyboard release clears the emulated A button
repeated pause key does not toggle twice
next distinct pause key resumes
virtual A button captures mouse and presses A
mouse release clears virtual A and capture
capture transfer releases virtual input and preserves new owner
foreground numpad tilt signal reaches cartridge
focus transfer reaches a second top-level window
focus loss releases keyboard, virtual buttons and capture
focus loss clears held turbo and rewind
focus loss pauses a running game
background numpad tilt cannot change cartridge input
background execution keeps rumble silent
focus return resumes a game paused by focus loss
foreground cartridge rumble reaches XInput callback
normal-speed menu clears turbo and selects 1x
quick-save slot menu selects slot nine
fullscreen command and Escape restore window

scope: Visible Win32 window messages, focus/capture transitions, menus and fullscreen. XInput and asynchronous tilt-key reads are deterministic test doubles. Physical controllers, GPU output, audible sound and human usability are outside this automated check.
